name: @mpd-dsh/team-tools-plugin
description: The team WORKFLOW the official Agent Teams plugin does not ship: a staged plan the user approves before anybody is spawned, task contracts frozen at claim time with a monotonic attempt counter, a halt that stops new dispatch without ending the team, and archive-first deletion. Sidecar in <workspace>/.mpd/team/; the roster and board stay the official service's, read through the adapter.
